fields.Name: W1 -> S5.4
fields.Description: Gate G0.10 (owner PR 2, phase 0, dataset W1, criterion S5.4): two single-threaded trainings each of logistic regression, xgboost, lightgbm and random forest on W1-signal s42, on the same snapshot, seed and code version, reproduce every candidate the run trains, 4 of 4: each returned artifact (the algorithm's finalist and every fitted simple baseline) by SHA-256 and each inner-CV candidate by its inner score within 1e-9 (OF4-53). This proves the validation split is seeded (an unseeded split changes every candidate's training rows) and the estimators are seeded (random forest bootstraps, so its finalist artifact moves if the estimator seed is dropped; the other three do not sample on their sidecar defaults), on a single-threaded sidecar (the truth-suite sidecar pins OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; thread-count nondeterminism is not tested). The delivered model alone is not the measure: when the gate ships a simple baseline every algorithm delivers the same one.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 4 of 4 algorithms reproduce every candidate (artifact SHA-256, inner score within 1e-9).
